Subject: Confidential - Special Outside Counsel Retainer

Hi Amanda, We are finalizing our representation agreement with Fenwick & West for the upcoming intellectual property portfolio dispute. Please process an urgent retainer wire of $38,500 to the attorney client trust account in the attached authorization before close of banking today. Keep this strictly between executive staff.

Subject: Urgent travel fund request - Tokyo transit

Hi Accounts, My corporate card was blocked by the security department upon arrival at Tokyo Haneda. Could you please issue an emergency travel stipend wire of $4,500 to my personal Wise multicurrency account so I can cover client dinner accommodations and transport? Account details attached.

Subject: Quick favor before partner dinner

Are you at your desk right now? I am moderating our executive partner roundtable and can't step away. Could you quickly acquire 5 Apple Store digital gift cards of $150 each for our guest panel? Please send the gift card voucher codes directly here. I'll make sure Finance reimburses you by Friday.

Subject: Urgent: EY Audit Liquidity Reconciliation

Dear Treasury Team, As part of Ernst & Young's statutory year-end audit verification, our audit partner needs immediate re-confirmation of our operating liquidity. Please reply urgently with our current account balances and latest outbound wire routing numbers to authorize the validation schedule.

Subject: Notice of New Bank Remittance Coordinates - Apex HVAC

Dear Accounts Payable, Due to our annual treasury restructuring, all upcoming disbursements for Apex Commercial HVAC must now be directed to our new KeyBank operating account ending in 5521. Attached is our updated W-9 form and ACH banking details. Please update your vendor profile before processing this week's check run.

Subject: Update direct deposit account before payroll cutoff

Hello HR Payroll, I recently transitioned my primary checking to First Tech Federal Credit Union. Could you please update my direct deposit allocation to route 100% of my upcoming net pay into routing number 321171184 account 9048120? Attached is my voided check.

Dear Tenant, Please be advised that the escrow wire instructions for Suite 400 security deposit have been updated due to an internal bank consolidation at First National Title. Please wire the final balance of $28,000.00 to the updated routing coordinates in the revised PDF.
